lines.en: label beachwars1:
scene buswarride1
At last, the time has come for yet another combination of events that should exist as their own individual entities, but have been lumped together because my class is predictably unpredictable.
The matter of whether or not this will measure up to last year’s “Halloween Wars” is yet to be determined-
But I am attempting to remain optimistic as swimsuits are right up there with Halloween costumes in my mental tier list of “Things I want girls to wear when they are communicating with me.”
But...
We just did this.
Albeit with a bit more tinsel, but still.
I remember it...Ayane and Maya remember it...and everyone else likely remembers it to some extent too — but it is only a handful of us who understand why.
If recent events are indicative of what’s to come, I’m sure Makoto may join the fray as well. But that doesn’t change the looming worry I have that things are beginning to spiral out of control.
With the pace things are moving, who’s to say that several more loops from now, we won't be going on a beach trip every other weekend?
And sure, that might not sound horrible to you, but I’d like to remind you at this point in time that things like swimsuits and costumes are only impactful because of how rarely they’re used.
I don’t want that to sour.
I don’t want life to become even more complicated than it already is.
And every time I find myself in situations like this one, that’s exactly what happens.
For the next two days, I will be the center of attention and the object of everyone’s affection.
They will dedicate themselves to me in a manner greater than what has become the standard.
And all the while, I will sink further into the sand knowing that there is no way this can continue without fully enveloping me and crushing my lungs.
Sometimes, it feels like I can not breathe.
Sometimes, that reminds me of you.
: So, how’s it feel knowing you only have an hour or two of freedom remaining before you become the carrot on the end of the metaphorical stick that is statutory rape?
: Metaphors lose their impact once you start pointing out what they stand for, Imani. Also, if I’m the carrot in this particular scenario, it absolves me of statutory anything.
: Yeah, well we’ll see what the judge has to say about that. Either way, must be pretty exciting being the prize for...what- the third year in a row?
: Yup. Which makes things very complicated when you realize they’re all first years-
scene buswarride2
: Hah...You’d think being the young and pretty student-teacher would mean that maybe I’d get to be the prize instead this year.
: But alas, it seems that the Internet was wrong about all teens nowadays being bisexual.
: I don’t think that’s something you need to worry about since at least half of our class seems to hold that preference. Also, which one of us sounds like a predator now?
scene buswarride3
: Hey. Watch it, buddy. Wanting girls to acknowledge your youth and bangability is way different than actually utilizing said bangability. Aristotle said that.
: No he didn’t.
: True. But he probably would have if he ever found himself on a bus full of jailbait.
: I don’t think you’re allowed to call them that.
: Yeah, that felt kind of gross coming out of my mouth. Be a bro and don’t tell HR, please. They’ve been on my case pretty hard lately and I want them to go away.
: What? Why are they on your case?
scene buswarride2
: Beats me. Maybe it’s all the melanin?
: Imani-
scene buswarride4
: They didn’t think it was “appropriate” for a fledgling teacher like me to propose rooming with my male superior. Something about giving people the wrong idea or whatever.

: Not like we had any other options, though. All the other rooms are booked and we’ve got twenty students to worry about. If you’re gonna get all handsy in the middle of the night, at least I can fight you off.
: But would you fight me off?
scene buswarride5
: That depends almost entirely on how much I’ve had to drink and the current lunar phase. I’m at my thirstiest during full moons, just FYI.
: Are you a werewolf now?
: Would it turn you on if I said yes?
: No, but it would make me question what constitutes bestiality — which is not a thing I’ve ever really had to question before.
: Also, are you sure about this? You and me sleeping in the same room? Won’t that just lead to...complications again?
scene buswarride6
: Like I said, we don’t have any other options and it’s not like I can let you crash with the girls. I’m cool if you’re cool. But on the off-chance you’re not...again, don’t go to HR.
: I won’t. And it’s not just because today was the first time I’ve ever heard of them being a department that actually exists in our school.
scene buswarride7
: Man, how come everybody just leaves you alone? If anyone should be making weekly check-ins with them, it’s you.
: Please stop blaming me for how loved I am by everyone and everything. I can’t help it.
scene buswarride8
: Would it kill you to be a little more humble at least? Because that shit might fly with me, but we both know Wakana’s gonna be chewing your ass out all weekend for saying things like that.
: Wakana? She’s coming too?
scene buswarride9
: Man, do you pay any attention to anything? She’s coming along to announce the winner of her poetry contest. Which, by the way, she’s super pissed at you for not entering.
: I don’t write anymore. Also, why not just stay with her instead of me if she’s going to be there?
: Uhhhh, because all three of us are staying together? Duh. We’ve got the cool teacher room where she and I are going to sleep in the same bed and you’re going to sleep in the closet.
: That revelation was really enticing until the very last part of it. But hey, at least I’ll still get to hear her and Osako going at it while you’re forced to join me in the closet.
scene buswarride10
: Osako’s not coming. She’s got a thing.
: A thing?
: Yeah, a thing. If I knew what it was, I would have said it. Just man up and accept that you’ll have to keep your hands off of two women tonight instead of just one.
: And also that Wakana is probably going to try and kill you and I won’t be able to stop her.
: I can handle Wakana. I’m not worried about her.
: You should probably be a little worried about her. She has a whip. I’ve seen it.
: Why have you seen it?
scene buswarride11
: Would you believe me if I said it was because I was a bad girl?
: Yes. Right before asking you to explain in vivid detail how and why.
: Well, I’m sorry to disappoint you but that’s not what happened. She just left it in her office and I happened to stumble across it after picking the lock to let myself in one day.
: Just lie to me next time, Imani.
: Why? So you can get a boner on the bus? That’s weird. Why would I want to give you a boner on the bus?
: Because I’m your superior and if I want to have a boner on the bus, I can have a boner on the bus.
: This is an abuse of power, Senpai.
scene black
: Your face is an abuse of power.
: Ah! Who heard that?! Sensei just made a joke that wasn’t “Hot boy summer!” He’s becoming a real boy!
: Just shut up and ride the bus, Imani.
scene buswarride12
: What are you playing, Sana? It seems a little...different from what you normally like.
: It’s...um...it’s...a first-person shooter called...DOOM Eternal...
scene buswarride13
: DOOM? But you’re the cute Animal Crossing girl. You like trees and fish and stuff. What are you doing playing something that graphic?
: The cyclops has entered her dark phase. Everything we know about her is to be cast aside so the true Sana Sakakibara can rise and Zagull Throat Spear’s ultimate form can be unleashed.
: Rin...got me into games like this...a while ago and...they’re really.............................
scene buswarride14
: Hah...
: Apologies, Arborea. It appears that the cyclops has simply been hexed and that there is no final form looming on the horizon.
: But given Zagull’s disposition, it is probably safe to assume that Sana has always been at least mildly interested in-
scene buswarride15
: Ahh!
: You died, didn’t you?
scene buswarride16
: I’m still not...very good at...fast-paced games like this...
: It’s hard to...um...improve after...not growing up with them...
scene buswarride17
: But...um...it’s not like I...don’t like things like this...I...
: Horror movies...are...
: Oh, right...you and Ayane watch stuff like that sometimes, don’t you? I totally forgot.
scene buswarride18
: R...Right...I’ve always...loved horror...but...since games are so...um...active, it’s...a little...
scene buswarride19
: Wait...why aren’t you...with Ayane right now?...
: Don’t...you two normally...
scene buswarride20
: I’d just rather sit here for now if that’s okay. I don’t...think Ayane wants to talk to me at the moment.
: Uh-oh. Sounds like a subplot.
: The main heroine and her best friend, hopelessly in love with the same man...must overcome adversity to rekindle their friendship and grow closer than ever be-
: Not right now, Molly...
scene buswarride21
: Sorry...just...trying to lighten the mood. We don’t mind if you sit here at all.
: And...umm...if it makes you...feel any better...I haven’t heard...Ayane say anything that...
: Just tell me more about your game, Sana. I don’t want to talk about any of that sad stuff right now.
scene black
: Well, umm...you see this...alien thing?
: That’s...actually...
scene buswarride22
: ...and that’s why I love otters. They’re like little sea puppies if puppies could hold hands and, like...you know. Live in the sea.
: Well, that was certainly the most Karin conversation I’ve ever had before.
scene buswarride23
: Huh? What do you mean?
: Oh, nothing bad! Just that talking to you is kind of, like...like...hugging a grandma or something.
: A grandma?
: Since you’re so wholesome. It’s like...like you’ve somehow managed to make it this far into life without ever acknowledging the crappier parts of it.
: She’s calling you boring.
scene buswarride24
: That’s absolutely not what I’m doing! I seriously didn’t mean anything bad by it!
: Talking to Karin is like...a nice breeze on a hot summer day! Or a...warm slice of pumpkin pie on a chilly November morning! I just don’t want to accidentally corrupt her!
: Soooo...what you’re saying is she’s boring.
: No! She’s just too pure to get sandwiched between degenerates like us!
: I guess I...do come across that way, don’t I?
scene buswarride25
: This isn’t the first time I’m hearing that, of course...A lot of the girls on the softball team have told me the same exact thing.
: Karin, why don’t you ever talk about boys?...Karin, what’s your craziest fantasy?...Karin, you’re going to make a great wife one day...
: Pretty sure that last one’s just a compliment, Sis.
: And a true one at that. You’re like, total wife material.
: I just...don’t really understand why it’s so easy for some people to openly talk about things like that.
: It’s not like I’m...unaware of the “crappier parts of life” or...that I don’t think about the same sorts of things other people think about.
: Those are just thoughts I think are better kept to myself because that’s what makes them special.
scene buswarride26
: Ugh. Even your explanation about not being pure is too pure.
: I’m okay with you tagging along for the Dorm Wars and whatnot, but if you’re going to keep that up all weekend, just don’t even bother.
: Uhh...well...what should I do to...look more like someone you’d want to hang out with? Because I can find a way to fit in with most groups, but...with you two, I’m...
scene buswarride27
: Just go suck a dick or something please. For all of our sakes.
: A...what?! Why would...anyone ever...
: Karin, you don’t need to do anything to fit in better with us. I think Kirin is just worried about making you uncomfortable.
: Sure, yeah. Let’s go with that.
scene buswarride28
: Noriko, you’re...not like Kirin too, are you? You know, like...saying such vulgar things all the time and...doing inappropriate stuff just to get a rise out of people?
: Me? I mean...maybe a little. But all things considered, I’m probably one of the most wholesome girls in the class.
: That’s a relief. Because Kirin’s been making it sound like everyone-
: Noriko, why not tell Karin about the time you went over to your boyfriend’s house and had him finger your brains out on the bed?
scene buswarride29
: Come on, Kirin. In front of Grandma? Really?
: You...
: Joke?...
: Joke...Yes? Joke?
scene buswarride30
: Boy, I’m sure excited to go to the beach.
: And I’m sure excited for Karin to suck her first dick fifty years from now so she can stop being so boring all the time.
scene black
: Joke?...
scene buswarride31
: What a lovely day. So bright...and sunny...it’s perfect for a fun competition like the Dorm Wars...isn’t that right, Touka?
scene buswarride32
: Touka?
: Huh? What?
: I apologize. Did you say something, Yasu? I wasn’t paying attention.
: Just that it’s a nice day for a competition...Are you excited to go to the beach?
scene buswarride33

: Yes...It’ll be a nice break from school-life. And I’d be lying if I said I haven’t been getting exhausted lately. What with all the bouncing around between the dorms, the manor, and my new apartment complex.
: Will you show me your new complex soon? I’m very excited to see it.
: Of course. I just need to put the finishing touches on your room first.
: Is it really okay for me to live there?
: Of course, Yasu. It’ll help me keep a closer eye on you so that nothing bad will happen.
: So you’ll protect me from the fraying of the rope and roots made of wire?
: ...Yes. That is exactly what I was referring to.
scene buswarride34
: Heheh! I’m so glad someone as nice and wonderful as you spends so much time with an insignificant whelp like me.
: Stop putting yourself down so much, Yasu. You’ve overcome more in just a few years than most people do in their entire lives.

: Life is full of obstacles! And if you’re not careful, you’ll fall into an endless pit of despair! But all of those obstacles are only there to test us. And we’ll be stronger than ever once we pass them all.
scene black
: I sure hope you’re right about that...
scene buswarride35
: You can’t avoid her forever, Ayane. She’s going to catch on.

: Yeah. Sorry, Maya. Let me just forget all of the terrifying shit you told me at the shrine and set up another slumber party. I see no way that can possibly go wrong with only one serial killer in attendance.
scene buswarride36
: Shh. We’re still on a bus, you know. This isn’t exactly the place to be discussing things like that.
: Why not? Everybody’s either going to just die or forget it, right? Or was it both? Because I honestly can’t remember.
scene buswarride37
: See, this is exactly why I didn’t want to tell you anything.
: All you knowing about this does is further complicate things while severing one of the very few ties Ami genuinely cares about.
: You said there was no one in class you haven’t seen something happen to. And I’m part of that class, right?
: Would she really do something that horrible to me if she cared about me? Who’s to say she’s not just faking it?
scene buswarride38
: You don’t get it, Ayane. She’s deeply traumatized and codependent. And as someone who loves him as much as you claim to, I wouldn’t put it past you to do the same exact thing if you had to.
: What is it that would make me “have” to, though? What does that even mean?
: Anything and everything so long as it ensures he’ll remain by your side.
: Are you saying you’d kill someone to keep Sensei as well?
scene buswarride39
: If I had to? Absolutely.
: Have you had to?
: You’ve been around a long time, right?
: It wouldn’t be surprising if something like that happened at least once.
: I’ve already told you more than I should have. Learning anything else will just make this even harder for you.
: Yeah, at this point, I’m not sure things can get any harder. I feel like I’ve been caught in a perpetual panic attack ever since leaving the shrine.
scene buswarride40
: Ayane...
: What, Maya?
scene buswarride41
: Ugh...
: I can’t believe I’m saying this, but...
: Would you...like...
: Do you...
: Want...a hug?
scene buswarride42
: Like...
: Like...from you?
: Is that not what friends are supposed to do in times like this?
: I think it’s normally a little more organic.
: Forgive me for being short on experience. I’m not a very “touchy” person.
: Yeah, this is weird.
: Very weird.
: Just forget I even asked.
scene buswarride43
: Sure...yeah.
: Hearing that helped, though.
: I might take you up on it later.
scene black
: Please don’t be in any rush...
